family_definition: all unique exact paired McNemar contrasts reported in the manuscript or its Revision 11 associated results; duplicated SVM tuning contrasts are counted once
interval_policy: Wilson and bootstrap intervals remain marginal effect-size uncertainty summaries; they are not claimed to provide simultaneous 95% coverage

results.holm_change: GossipCop selected-vs-fixed Linear SVM raw p=0.02599 becomes Holm-adjusted p>0.05; all other nominally significant contrasts remain significant under Holm
